title: Yes, Q-learning Helps Offline In-Context RL
abstract: arXiv:2502.17666v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing offline in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) methods have predominantly relied on supervised training objectives, which are known to have limitations in offline RL settings. In this study, we explore the integration of RL objectives within an offline ICRL framework. Through experiments on more than 150 GridWorld and MuJoCo environment-derived datasets, we demonstrate that optimizing RL objectives directly improves performance by approximately 30% on average compared to widely adopted Algorithm Distillation (AD), across various dataset coverages, structures, expertise levels, and environmental complexities. Furthermore, in the challenging XLand-MiniGrid environment, RL objectives doubled the performance of AD. translated_title: 是的，Q学习有助于离线情境强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.17666v5 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：现有的离线情境强化学习（ICRL）方法主要依赖于监督训练目标，这些目标在离线RL设置中已知存在局限性。在本研究中，我们探索了在离线ICRL框架中整合RL目标的可能性。通过在超过150个GridWorld和MuJoCo环境派生数据集上的实验，我们证明，与广泛采用的算法蒸馏（AD）方法相比，优化RL目标直接提升了性能，平均约提高30%，涵盖不同的数据集覆盖度、结构、专业水平以及环境复杂性。此外，在具有挑战性的XLand-MiniGrid环境中，RL目标使AD的性能翻倍。我们的结果还表明，在价值学习过程中加入保守性在几乎所有测试设置中都能带来额外改进。我们的发现强调了将ICRL学习目标与RL目标对齐的重要性。
tldr: 本研究证明在离线情境强化学习中直接优化强化学习目标（如Q学习）能显著提升性能，平均比算法蒸馏高约30%，并在复杂环境中效果更佳，同时加入保守性可进一步改善结果。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that directly optimizing reinforcement learning objectives, such as Q-learning, in offline in-context RL significantly improves performance, averaging ~30% over Algorithm Distillation, with further gains from added conservatism.
